info.title: InventoryBase Universal API
info.description: InventoryBase provides property, inspection, report, client, staff, template, webhook, file sharing, and configuration APIs for property inventory and inspection workflows.

ignoreWelcomeMailer.description: Whether to suppress the initial welcome email.
